# 3 bed detached house for sale

> Situated on the outskirts of Skibbereen town in West Cork, this three bed detached property with outbuildings, set on 0.5 acre approximately offers an excellent opportunity for those seeking a renovation project in a convenient and well-established location. The property extends to 100 sq. m. (1,074 sq. ft.) approx., and provides well-proportioned accommodation over two floors.

## Fakta
- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 3 bed
- Plocha: 100 m²
- Energetická náročnost: G
- Lokalita: Coolnagurrane, Skibbereen
- Cena: 195 000 €
